sources.title: Road Repair Contracts | Example County Auditor
sources.text: Issued Date October 1, 2026. Example County Auditor: Road Repair Contracts. The auditor found that 9 of 30 sampled road repair contracts were paid before the county engineer signed the inspection certificate. The Public Works Department agreed to review its payment controls by March 2027. The department said most of the early payments involved emergency repairs.
